note: Legacy quarantine for the cross-repo execution boundary (issue #388). An entry excuses one (code, subject) pair ONLY while the issue tracking it is still open; when that issue closes, the entry itself becomes a stale finding. The quarantine therefore shrinks as legacy closes and cannot grow silently - a new cross-repo child fails immediately. tracked_by #358 (Board attack plan, milestone-epic-class) is the open PMO artifact that enumerates and tracks the 11 vendor-compliance children (#126-#137) to closure; the brief's fallback #125 (the vendor-compliance epic) is CLOSED, so using it would make every entry stale on day one.
